_about: The demo of the games template: one campaign, a game master and three players. Read by server/demo-loader.js, which writes it through the real module routes; the format is described in templates/demo/travel.json and the loader. Dates are offsets: "start" is the next session (today plus "anchor" days).

# Session notes

## Session 3: The lighthouse keeper

- Climbed the lighthouse in the dark. Garran fell once and blamed the stairs.
- Found Old Harrow's log. Last page: "The bells ring for her. Not for us."
- First sight of the Tide Court, down in the water below the rocks.

## Session 2: Smugglers' tide

- Struck a deal with the Net-Menders at the Copper Kettle.
- Chase through the net sheds. Sable lost her hat and kept the map.
- The two halves of the chart meet at the old lighthouse.

## Session 1: The wreck at Gull Point

- Met on the coast road in a storm.
- Salvaged the captain's chest: half a chart, a silver bell, a wet letter.
- A stranger in the tide pools watched us, then walked into the sea.

## Next session

Under Saltmere. Bring the bell.

doc:handharr.preview:
# Harrow's last letter

*Found folded inside the lighthouse log, written in a shaking hand.*

To whoever keeps the light after me,

The bells began on the first night of the new moon. Three of them, under the harbour, where no church has stood for two hundred years.

I rowed out to listen. Something below was singing the old court songs. It knew my name.

text:handharr:handhac1.text:
# Harrow's last letter

*Found folded inside the lighthouse log, written in a shaking hand.*

To whoever keeps the light after me,

The bells began on the first night of the new moon. Three of them, under the harbour, where no church has stood for two hundred years.

I rowed out to listen. Something below was singing the old court songs. It knew my name.

If you find the captain's chest, do not ring the bell. Not until you have all three.

H.

doc:rulesgm1.title: House rules
doc:rulesgm1.excerpt: House rules Sessions start at 7. We stop at 10:30, even mid-fight. If you miss a session, your character is "busy in town" and keeps their share. Roll in the open. The GM rolls behind the screen. Anyone can call a pause, no questions asked. Snacks rotate: see Costs.

messages.text: Welcome to the Salt Crown. Session 4 is in three days, same place, 7 sharp.
Brisa is ready. She has been staring at that silver bell all week.
Garran has had two diving lessons. He can hold his breath for almost a minute.

> almost a minute
That is not long, Garran.
The Campaign has the next sessions, and the scenes I have so far: {base}/modules/schedule?space={space}
Saw it. "Bargain with the eel king" sounds like my kind of night.
I put Old Harrow and the Tide Court in Lore, with what we found out.
Who has the letter? I want to read it again before we go down.
It is in Documents as a handout: Harrow's last letter.
Reminder: snacks poll. Dumplings are winning.
Please level up your sheets before we play, there is a reminder in Sessions.
And vote for the night of session 6. I will lock it at the weekend.
I am away for a few days later in the month, it is on the calendar. Play without Sable if you need to.

> Play without Sable
She will be "busy in town", as the house rules say.
Bringing the dice that roll badly so they can learn from the good ones.
